text: District Court for the Western District of Texas (the Patent Litigation ), alleging patent infringement by the Company relating to its PUR gravity-fed water filtration systems.
International Trade Commission ( ITC ) against Kaz USA, Inc., Helen of Troy Limited and five other unrelated companies that sell water filtration systems (the ITC Action ).
The complaint in the ITC Action also alleged patent infringement by the Company with respect to a limited set of PUR gravity-fed water filtration systems.
In the ITC Action, Brita LP requested the ITC to initiate an unfair import investigation relating to such filtration systems.
